The '''Pocket Secretary''' was a combined [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] and audio recording device with included administrative software built in. It could assist the user in data searches, computations, scheduling and many other tasks. It could also record up to 12 hours of audio on a standard [[Datacard/Legends|datacard]].

Its administrative programming could operate independently of the owner and keep track of schedules, reorder supplies and perform basic accounting functions.
